_name.description: Internal-only project codename or alias. For data/reference use only; never show in generated resumes or public output.

_summary.description: Private project summary for your own reference. Never show in generated resumes or public output.

roles.description: Clarify what parts of the project you personally designed, built, or maintained.

company.description: Optional link to an experience.company value

team.description: Optional link to a value in experience.teams. When set, company+team must match an experience entry.

school.description: Optional link to an education.name value

current_project.description: True when this is an ongoing project

challenges.description: Public-facing challenges, framed positively for resume and portfolio use.

_challenges.description: Private challenge context for your own reference. Never show in generated resumes or public output.

lessons_learned.description: Takeaways and reflections from the project

_lessons_learned.description: Private lessons for your own reference. Never show in generated resumes or public output.

scale_and_scope.description: Scale and scope signals for the system, such as user counts, data volume, or transaction frequency handled.

measurable_results.description: Share data-driven outcomes instead of simple task lists, such as "Optimized search API – cut response time 60% for front-end display."

decisions_and_tradeoffs.description: Briefly explain why you chose specific architectural patterns or how you solved complex constraints.

description.description: What you personally designed, built, or maintained in this role.
